preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module_url WHERE url_path = '/ResultValidation' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.comment: Map lower-case SPA route /validation to the same modules as /ResultValidation
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_module_url (id, url_path, system_module_id, system_module_param_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_module_url_seq'), '/validation', smu.system_module_id, smu.system_module_param_id FROM clinlims.system_module_url smu WHERE smu.url_path = '/ResultValidation' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module_url existing WHERE existing.url_path = '/validation' AND existing.system_module_id = smu.system_module_id AND COALESCE(existing.system_module_param_id, -1) = COALESCE(smu.system_module_param_id, -1) );
